serving_evidence.note: The :8031 instance currently reports exchange_snapshot_status=UNAVAILABLE for its own data dir, so product behaviour was exercised on isolated instances (:8147..:8151) running identical code bytes (same sha256) with per-fixture data dirs; each probe record names its port and fixture.

rows.probe: GET 127.0.0.1:8150/live-copy (regE) DOM #lcRealCards; GET :8151 (regM, send_attempts.csv deleted); GET :8148 (regB)
rows.why_row_specific: Card text equals latest ORDER_FILLED send_attempt (BTC BUY 0.01 @ 61000, attempt a-201, oid 900201) read independently from CSV, and becomes "none yet" when that CSV is absent.
Card equals latest ORDER_REJECTED row (ETH SELL, attempt a-202, terminal REJECTED) and is empty-safe when the CSV is absent.
All 5 plotted y-values equal value-first_visible mapped through the observed axis.

rows.probe: GET :8150 SVG #lcRealizedPath@points; cumulative closedPnl over range
rows.why_row_specific: Path steps at exactly the closedPnl timestamps (+20,-5,+30) ending at +45 cumulative.
Every drawdown point equals pnl minus running peak; the -50 trough follows the 10100 peak.

rows.probe: GET :8150: click [data-lc-graph-mode=wallet_pnl], then click row 0 and row 1 on :8148 (two-wallet fixture)
rows.why_row_specific: NOT_TESTED rather than FAIL: live_leader_performance[].pnl_series is empty in every fixture, so a per-wallet curve cannot be demonstrated; the empty state itself renders honestly.
NOT_TESTED: exposure_series is a single current-value point in this build, so a multi-point exposure curve is never produced.
Applied control state is echoed in #lcGraphSubtitle with the exact selected window and the plotted path changes, proving filtering.
Each row displays its own shortWallet(live_config key), matching the config keys read independently.
Row mode label equals the fixture live_config mode with no cross-row bleed.

rows.probe: GET :8150 and :8148 eligibility sub-label of the mode cell
rows.why_row_specific: Eligibility text derives from mode+service_eligible per row: COPYING / CLOSE ONLY / DISABLED.
Pill reflects live_ws_health current_status per wallet and degrades to NO WS HEALTH with an explicit reason when absent.

rows.probe: GET :8150 (EXACT realized), :8141 regA (account-level only), :8149 regN (snapshot unavailable)
rows.why_row_specific: Realized PnL shown only for the exactly-attributed wallet ($20, matched closedPnl oid 900201) and suppressed to n/a otherwise.

rows.probe: GET :8150 (owned sleeve vs exchange mark) and :8149 (snapshot unavailable)
rows.why_row_specific: The $1,000 equals independently computed owned-sleeve unrealized and is withheld when the snapshot is unavailable or attribution is account-level.

rows.probe: GET :8150 and :8149 net PnL field of the same cell
rows.why_row_specific: Net equals realized+unrealized for the exact fixture and is suppressed when either component is unsafe.
